significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish a form-(iii) law: backdoor-feature activation varies smoothly with perturbation distance, and measurable surface geometry—"sharpness, semantic breadth, dimensionality"—predicts both trigger family and which mitigation succeeds. This constrains expected activation and attack behavior for unseen trigger variants and fixes a defense-routing decision, rather than merely establishing the form-(ii) probe-and-steer pattern used around sleeper-agent mechanisms in Hubinger et al., "Sleeper Agents" (2024), and MacDiarmid et al., "Simple probes can catch sleeper agents" (2024). It establishes both a behavioral phenomenon (graded trigger generalization) and an internal feature-level mechanism; the distinguishable negative branch would rule out smooth-feature trigger recovery or the proposed geometry-to-mitigation coupling, although it would not exclude all other recovery mechanisms. After substituting away the specific smooth-surface law and predictive fingerprint, the generic safety-interpretability topic would not merit this score, so the rating comes from the claim-specific conclusion.

reach.justification: The named handles are "human-readable approximate triggers" and the surface descriptors "sharpness, semantic breadth, dimensionality," used as a "mitigation-routing fingerprint." They are ex ante in the stated "open-weight supply-chain vetting" and "pre-deployment red-team" settings: an auditor could recover candidate triggers, generate canaries or retraining data, and select ablation versus broader retraining before deployment. Although directions require re-extraction, the claimed sharp/narrow-to-ablation and broad/semantic-to-retraining relation predicts what auditors should find across a class of backdoors; downstream users therefore include model auditors and deployment teams, while white-box access, deliberately installed backdoors, and possible adaptive multi-basin surfaces limit broader transfer. With the specific trigger-recovery and predictive-routing handles removed, the topic alone would not support this score, so the topic-substitution check passes.
